# Drop

> Drop is a native macOS utility that monitors your clipboard for video links and downloads them instantly, in the highest available quality, with a single shortcut (Control+D).

Drop runs quietly in the background. Copy a video link from any app or browser, press Control+D, and Drop downloads the video at the highest quality available — no need to open an app, paste a link, or pick a format.

## Key facts

- Platform: macOS 15.0 and later
- Core interaction: copy a video URL, press Control+D, the video downloads automatically
- Pricing: free
- Category: utility / productivity / video downloader
- Publisher: The Atom (https://theatom.lk)

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://drop.theatom.lk/): product overview, demo video, and download link for macOS
